The '''Cerise Research Laboratory''' (Japanese: '''サクラギ{{tt|研究所|けんきゅうしょ}}''' ''Sakuragi Institute''), or the '''Cerise Laboratory''' for short, is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive [[Pokémon Research Lab]] located in [[Vermilion City]] in the [[Kanto]] [[region]]. It is directed by [[Professor Cerise]], who works there with his [[Professor's assistant|research assistants]] [[Chrysa]] and [[Ren]]. It also serves as {{Ash}} and [[Goh]]'s base of operations during ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''.

==Structure==
A domed area known as '''Cerise Park''' (Japanese: '''サクラギパーク''' ''Sakuragi Park'') is located inside the lab. Ash and Goh keep their [[caught Pokémon]] there whenever they are not on a research mission.

In ''[[JN002|Legend? Go! Friends? Go!]]'', the Cerise Laboratory officially opened as a Pokémon research facility. However, the building itself is significantly older and was abandoned for a time, as revealed in ''[[JN016|A Chilling Curse!]]''. Three years prior, a {{AP|Gengar}} haunted the facility after it was abandoned by [[Gengar's former Trainer|its former Trainer]]. Professor Cerise was well aware of the haunting rumors when he purchased the building but was unfazed by it. The occurrences soon subsided once the Gengar gave up trying to scare him. However, in ''[[JN011|Best Friend...Worst Nightmare!]]'', the supernatural occurrences resumed, likely because of new arrivals like Ash and Goh taking residence there. Eventually, Ash {{pkmn2|caught}} the Gengar.

In ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', as stated by Professor Cerise, the Pokémon created their own unique habitats just like in the real world. In [[JN107|some instances]], a Pokémon from another habitat ended up invading the habitat of others, creating an imbalance and some problems which had to be solved by those responsible for taking care of the Pokémon in place. Some Pokémon are responsible for the food, especially {{TP|Goh|Raichu}}, and others for taking care of the order, something done by {{TP|Professor Cerise|Yamper}}.
